because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

notes.note: This could mean: (1) they did not love God. Alternate translation: [love for God]; (2) they had not received God’s love. Alternate translation: [love from God]

notes.note: John records Jesus using the word name to refer to authority. If this might confuse your readers, you could express the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [If another comes in his own authority]

because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

so that the proven character of your faith— more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire— may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

notes.quote: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι, δόξαν παρὰ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες, καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου Θεοῦ, οὐ ζητεῖτε

notes.note: Moses here could refer to: (1) the person named Moses who gave the Israelites the law of Moses. (2) the law of Moses itself. Alternate translation: [Moses accuses you in the law, the very law in which you have hoped]

notes.note: John records Jesus making a conditional statement that sounds hypothetical, but he is already convinced that the condition is not true. Alternate translation: [you must not believe Moses since you do not believe me]
